column2: Character: a veteran heavy knight in his forties, broad and powerful, short dark beard; a rounded great helm with the visor raised showing his face, a tall plume of cream off-white feathers on the crest; polished silver plate pauldrons, breastplate, gauntlets and greaves over mail; a plain cream off-white surcoat (tabard) to the knee over the breastplate and a cream off-white cloak lining; dark leather belt with a steel buckle; a broad arming sword in his right hand pointing down and a heater shield with a plain cream off-white face and a steel rim strapped on his left forearm.

The animal: a heavy medieval warhorse (destrier), powerful and deep-chested, bay-brown coat with dark mane and tail, feathered hooves; a polished steel chanfron on its face and a steel crinet on its neck; a full cloth caparison (barding) over its body to the knees, plain cream off-white with a thin gold trim at the hem; a dark leather saddle with a high back and steel stirrups; leather bridle and reins. No rider.

Character: a sturdy spearman in his thirties, short beard; a steel kettle helm with a wide brim; a mail hauberk to the knee with steel shoulder plates; a plain cream off-white tabard to the knee with a broad cream chest panel; brown leather belt; a long ash spear held upright in his right hand, its butt on the ground beside his foot; a kite shield with a plain cream off-white face and steel rim strapped on his left forearm.

Character: a broad veteran man-at-arms in his forties, stubble; an open-faced steel bascinet with a mail aventail; mail shirt with steel plate shoulders, steel vambraces and greaves; a plain cream off-white tabard to the knee; brown leather belt; an arming sword held in his right hand pointing down beside his leg; a round shield with a plain cream off-white face and a steel boss and rim on his left forearm.

Character: a lean longbowman in his twenties, short beard; a plain cream off-white hood up over a steel cap; a quilted padded gambeson in warm brown; a plain cream off-white tabard to the knee over it; brown leather belt and bracer; a tall longbow held in his left hand pointing down, a quiver of arrows on his back with the fletchings over his right shoulder; boots.
